title: M-Plan: Comprehensive Planning For LLM Agents with Memory Arrangement
abstract: arXiv:2610.27032v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents have recently demonstrated outstanding performance in single-turn tasks, yet they continue to struggle with long-horizon tasks, particularly in environments without prior training. A key limitation of single LLMs is their difficulty in processing long contexts, which stems from weaknesses in continuous decision-making and reasoning capabilities. Although existing multi-agent systems (MAS) equipped with long-term memory bases can partially address this gap, they mostly rely on knowledge reuse or summarization, an approach that is often constrained by directly retrieval without any adaptation for the current task, while the retrieved memory may contain much history noises waiting to be preprocessed. In contrast, MAS characterized by task-specific guidance often lack long-term memory specifically designed for the guidance. translated_title: M-Plan：基于记忆编排的LLM智能体综合规划
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体近来在单轮任务中展现出卓越性能，但它们在长时程任务中仍然表现不佳，尤其是在缺乏预先训练的环境中。单一LLM的一个关键局限在于难以处理长上下文，这源于其持续决策与推理能力的不足。尽管配备长期记忆库的现有多智能体系统（MAS）能够在一定程度上弥补这一差距，但它们大多依赖知识重用或摘要，这种方式往往受限于不加适配的直接检索，同时检索到的记忆中可能包含大量等待预处理的历史噪声。相比之下，以任务特定指导为特征的MAS又往往缺乏专门为此类指导设计的长期记忆。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了M-Plan，一个闭环MAS框架……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出M-Plan——一个闭环多智能体框架，通过为当前任务编排与适配长期记忆并结合任务特定指导，解决了LLM智能体在长时程任务中记忆利用受限与规划能力不足的问题。
en_tdlr: M-Plan is a closed-loop multi-agent framework that enables comprehensive planning for LLM agents on long-horizon tasks by arranging long-term memories to be adapted to task-specific guidance, overcoming the limits of direct retrieval and noisy history in existing memory-based MAS.
